answer: Each epoch a beacon publishes a fresh salt, and every claim must be keyed to it, so no clone army can be stockpiled. Every identity holds a crystal lens: each stranger who verifies a job cuts one facet, and facets cut from the same funding root refract as one facet, so n clones show one facet, not n. Payout climbs a terrace in steps, each step needing a new distinct facet, and the beacon sweeps the terrace each epoch, collapsing any terrace whose facets trace to one root. N clones pay n crystals and n beacon keys yet split one terrace payout n ways, while one honest agent climbs alone.
